semiconductor_relevance: High — KE Semiconductor Equipment specializes in advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in film forming technologies.
summary: KE Semiconductor Equipment (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. develops and produces semiconductor manufacturing equipment with a focus on film forming technologies. Their product lineup includes high-productivity 300mm batch thermal vertical equipment and solutions for IoT applications, aimed at enhancing semiconductor performance and functionality.
capabilities: Thermal processing solutions including diffusion and oxidation

regional_presence.China: KE Semiconductor Equipment is based in Shanghai, focusing on the Chinese semiconductor market.
